name: RuneScape Quick-Screen
author: Carl Kaufman
description: Quick-access popup scratchpad, Jagex account launcher, and AFK/idle notification flasher for Old School RuneScape (RuneLite).

barWidget.description: Old School RuneScape bar widget with popup scratchpad view, Jagex launcher login, and flashing idle alerts.

schema.label: Show Character Name on Bar
schema.description: Display character name next to the crossed swords icon on the bar, or icon only.

schema.label: Popup Width (px)
schema.description: Width of the floating game popup window.

schema.label: Popup Height (px)
schema.description: Height of the floating game popup window.

schema.label: Auto-hide when clicking outside
schema.description: Automatically dismiss the game screen back to background when focus shifts to another window or desktop.

schema.label: Flash bar icon on AFK / idle
schema.description: Pulsing amber/red flashing animation when you stop mining or go idle.
